issues.title: Bidi punctuation flipping and adornment placement
issues.description: Helper texts misplace trailing punctuation to the left, and loading indicators sit detached on the far left.
issues.evidence: Periods precede helper text strings, and the work email input displays a spinner disconnected on the left.
issues.suggestion: Apply dir='auto' or unicode-bidi isolation and mirror start/end adornment slots.
issues.triageNote: Real bidi defect, verified by playwright geometry probe on pair-150 (trailing '.' of Latin help text rendered leftmost, before the sentence; re-audit also showed '@' flipping in 'nadia.haddad@'). Fixed with dir="auto" on label/helpText spans and on Input/TextArea controls (Latin copy keeps terminal punctuation/'@' placement; Arabic content stays RTL — re-probed pair-016, unchanged). The 'spinner detached' half is a false positive: probe shows the spinner inside the field at the end edge, ~2px from vertical center, correctly mirrored trailing slot; the perceived gap was the start-aligned input text, and with dir=auto the LTR email now sits adjacent to the spinner.
